name: Nigerian Coco Pops
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Stir in the coco pops, then the milk.

culture.text: Cocoa Krispies is a breakfast cereal produced by WK Kellogg Co marketed both as a boxed cereal and as a snack bar with a 'dried milk' covered bottom. It is a cocoa flavored version of Rice Krispies which contains real chocolate.
